question: A wall 12 m long, 9 m high and 30 cm thick is to be constructed. How many bricks will be required if all bricks are of the same size of length 24 cm, breadth 18 cm and height 15 cm?
solution:
Given:

Dimension of the wall = 12 m × 9 m × 30 cm = 12 × 9 × 0.3 (in meters)

Dimension of the brick = 24 cm × 18 cm × 15 cm = 0.24 × 0.18 × 0.15 (in meters)
